text.formatted: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
text.plain: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

text.formatted: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
text.plain: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

text.formatted: _Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. _Hit:_ 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
text.plain: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
